ci-bot: 🚨 pipeline alert — main build failed after merge 0d4e5f6 (author: @Priya). Failed job: integration_gpu (matrix=8gpu) — timeout
Alex P: who merged last? pinging owners :eyes:
Priya: that was a docs + config patch (small). I didn't touch scheduler but will check. @Rohit any idea?
Kim: I can grab first look. Is there a failing test id?
Alex P: logs show flaky test `integration/kv_sync_test::large_shard_timeout` with "Timed out after 300s waiting for background sync"
Alex P: log snippet:
```
[ RUN      ] kv_sync_test.large_shard_timeout
... waiting for background-sync... elapsed=245.12s
ERROR: Timeout waiting for sync. pending_shards=12 leader_election=0
stack: runtime.goroutine exit... 
```
Rohit: hmmm seen similar flake on 8GPU clusters — suspect scheduler/eviction timing after the autoscaler tweak.
Maya: can we rerun the failing job only? I'll hit rerun from CI UI if someone confirms.
Alex P: please rerun, and also capture node/pod events. Commit range to bisect: last green 0a1b2c3 -> new d4e5f6g
oncall: grabbing rerun now, will post links
ci-bot: rerun 1769999999.1 started by oncall
oncall: rerun done: unit/cpu green, integration_gpu still flaky (same timeout)
Kim: suggestion: try reproduce locally with 8 workers. Command:
```
./run_integration.sh --job integration_gpu --workers 8 --test kv_sync_test::large_shard_timeout
```
Priya: opening revert PR for the config part of the merged change to be safe. PR: https://git/infra/reverts/123
Rohit: starting automated bisect across commits d4e5f6g..0a1b2c3, will spawn matrix runs
Alex P: if bisect is slow, decide between hot revert vs holding merges. I'd prefer revert if we see same failure reproduces quickly :thumbsup:
Maya: adding quick checklist: 1) node counts 2) pod evictions 3) kubelet logs 4) autoscaler activity
Priya: temporary alert added on queue_backlog metric for the integration cluster
oncall: rerun 1769999999.2 started
ci-bot: rerun 1769999999.2 completed — still failing at ~245s
Kim: I reproduced locally with bazel test, timing matches. Kernel param ci-rcp bumped in recent infra change — suspect
Alex P: assigning to Rohit + Kim for kernel/infra deep-dive. @Rohit @Kim please update thread with root cause or if you want a revert
Rohit: taking it. launching bisect jobs and collecting kubelet dmesg across builds
Priya: pausing canary deploys for the next hour
oncall: tagging this thread incident:sev=minor pipeline-red-blocking-merges and adding links to runs
Maya: if bisect lands on autoscaler, ping me and I'll revert the autoscaler gate
Alex P: thanks all — keep updates short here. If you need handoff, call me. :eyes:
